prompt_template: Compile the raw problem into the complete structured canonical Problem PIR only. Do not write learner-facing prose and do not use learner state. Emit problem objects, roles, all prerequisites a novice could require, dependencies, canonical microsteps, invariants, representation requirements, assessment targets, exercise requirements, optional expansion hooks, misconception candidates, and the abstraction/generalization path. Personalization happens later during traversal and must not delete nodes from the canonical decomposition.
